verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for a government revenue agency, since agencies can offer programmatic tax-rate lookups or e-filing APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows interactive web workflows (My DOR, Express file, file upload, phone system), and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. There is no documented public API to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
